messages:
Rae (eng-platform): quick thought: run probes + full 1% shadows, then instant swap when composite health < threshold. Keep shadows non-blocking.
June (architecture): instant swaps ok if we have hysteresis and precondition checks (capacity + cost). also need audit events.
Kai (eng-runtime): mirrors must be fire-and-forget; bounded queue with drop. tag X-Shadow. avoid KV writes.
Iris (eng-sre): probe cadence should be adaptive: baseline low, increase on anomaly; require target capacity check before swap. add cooldown to prevent thrash.
Tao (eng-ml): stratify probes by seq_len and call-type; include small semantic prompt set for drift detection.
ops-bot: mirror-pipeline: deployed to staging; probe-agent: running
Rae (eng-platform): config sketch: {mirror_rate:0.01, probes:{short:1/m, long:0.2/m}, swap_threshold:0.7, cooldown:300s, preconditions:[capacity,cost]}
June (architecture): action items: Kai proto mirror path, Tao assemble prompts, Iris write gating rules, Rae draft RFC. will add route-level opt-out. :thumbsup:
